title: PC Gore Confirmation – July Evidence Was Never Reviewed
summary:
Despite being told in April 2025 that Ben Carter's July 2024 evidence was 'central to the investigation', written confirmation from PC Gore dated 25 July 2024 proves otherwise. PC Gore stated: 'This matter is going to be filed… No offence is identified… She’s not even going to get a knock at the door.' This confirms that Sussex Police made a premature decision to close the case without reviewing key evidence, including a recorded call disclosing emotional manipulation, direct threats, false admissions, and a plea for protection.

Months later, the same evidence was requested again—only to be excluded on the grounds that the case scope would be limited to incidents from November 2024 onwards. This is not an administrative error; it is a deliberate pattern of institutional dishonesty, strategically designed to avoid accountability for suppressing the most serious part of the original disclosure.
quotes: This matter is going to be filed… No offence is identified… She’s not even going to get a knock at the door.
I was told it was central to the investigation — but it had never been heard.
They made me resubmit the call, then excluded it. That’s not admin. That’s strategy.
The request to resubmit what was never used—only to exclude it—is proof of systemic safeguarding failure.
